text:
Mila: Heads-up — while onboarding the new model bundle on staging I hit a weird tokenizer delta: a sentinel token seems to be inserted before the user prompt when using chat-template v2. That shifts indices in the KV cache and makes responses misaligned.
Ravi: which weights bundle did you use? path?
Mila: gs://redwood-models/onboard/llama3-ish/weights/sha12345
Sam: can you paste the tokenizer config you used? specifically any `add_bos` / `add_eos` flags.
Mila: minimal repro + token counts below (ran our token-counter script):
```
$ python tools/token_count.py --model-config staging/tokenizer.json --text "<user>Hello\nAssistant:"
tokens: [502, 198, 3, 1]
count: 4
```
But when going through chat-template v2 wrapper we see one extra sentinel token at the start.
Mila: tokenizer snippet from staging config:
```
{
  "type": "byte_bpe",
  "add_bos": true,
  "add_eos": false,
  "special_tokens": {
    "<|user|>": 502,
    "<|assistant|>": 198,
    "<|sentinel|>": 3
  }
}
```
Jordan: ah — chat-template v2 already prepends `<|sentinel|>` in the prompt builder. If tokenizer also has `add_bos: true` we end up with two leading tokens.
Sam: can we normalize in the input pipeline? either remove `add_bos` in tokenizer for chat flows or stop the template from injecting sentinel.
Mila: I ran quick experiment: toggling `add_bos` to false in the tokenizer fixed the off-by-one for chat-template v2. But that might break non-chat single-shot prompts.
Ashley: can you open a PR to make this explicit with a fast unit test and a patch note in model-metadata? I can review.
Mila: created draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ml-onboard/pull/789 — includes a unit test that compares token counts for template v1/v2.
Ravi: do we need to update model-metadata.yaml (weights location + canonical tokenizer flags)? if so, include the canonical `tokenization.overrides.chat_templates: v2` entry.
Mila: suggested metadata change (snippet):
```
model-metadata.yaml:
weights_path: gs://redwood-models/onboard/llama3-ish/weights/sha12345
tokenization:
  add_bos: false  # recommended for chat-template v2
  special_tokens: ["<|user|>", "<|assistant|>", "<|sentinel|>"]
```
Jordan: small nit — add a migration note to the onboarding checklist so Dedicated/Private ops know this toggle matters for existing deployments.
ops-bot: smoke-test: tokenizer sanity checks passed on staging for commit sha: abcd123 (3/3 tests) :white_check_mark:
Sam: I'll take ownership of the rollout. Plan: merge the PR to staging, run the canary on a subset of Dedicated slots for 2 hours, check deltas in token counts and latency. If token-delta > 0.3% or latency regresses >1%, rollback.
Ashley: pinged on PR for review.
Mila: thanks — I'll add a short note in the onboarding doc and link the PR. Will also add a tiny snippet to the tokenizer test harness to run both template variants nightly.
Sam: tagging ops: @Ravi please coordinate Dedicated canary window tomorrow 10:00-11:00 PST.
Ravi: got it, will reserve the window and post the canary checklist.
Mila: leaving logs and the minimal repro in the PR description. If anyone has quick ideas for a safer default (so single-shot prompts keep working), speak now — otherwise we go with `add_bos: false` as canonical for chat models and add an explicit opt-in for single-shot mode.
Jordan: makes sense. thanks for catching this fast.
Ashley: :thumbsup:
